figures.finding: In October 2021 the Ministry of Entertainment, Entrepreneurship and Talent Development said it was working with the Ministry of Finance to introduce a Production Expenditure Rebate Programme of cash rebates on spend in St Kitts and Nevis; no enactment was found.
figures.applies: St Kitts and Nevis; as the Government Information Service reported (2021-10-26).

sources.said: “MoENT is currently working closely with the Ministry of Finance to introduce an incentives programme in the form of a Production Expenditure Rebate Programme. … Qualifying production expenditures are those that must be spent within St. Kitts and Nevis.”

sources.title: St. Kitts and Nevis moves to establish a production expenditure rebate programme to boost the film industry (SKNIS, 26 Oct 2021)
